verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
It is God, the Gracious
Who has taught the Qur’an.
He has created man.
[✲]He has taught him plain speech.
The sun and the moon run their courses according to a fixed reckoning.
w: run their courses according to a fixed reckoning

verses.en: And the stemless plants and the trees humbly submit to His will.
And the heaven He has raised high and set up a measure,
That you may not transgress the measure.

verses.ar: وَاَقِیۡمُوا الۡوَزۡنَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُوا الۡمِیۡزَانَ ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: So weigh all things in justice and fall not short of the measure.
And He has set the earth for His creatures;
Therein are all kinds of fruit and palm-trees with sheaths,
And grain with its husk and fragrant plants.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny, O men and Jinn?
He created man from dry ringing clay which is like baked pottery.

verses.ar: وَخَلَقَ الۡجَآنَّ مِنۡ مَّارِجٍ مِّنۡ نَّارٍ ﴿ۚ۱۶﴾
verses.en: And the Jinn He created from the flame of fire.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
The Lord of the two Easts and the Lord of the two Wests!
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
[✲]He has made the two bodies of water flow. They will one day meet.
Between them is now a barrier; they encroach not one upon the other.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
There come out from them pearls and coral.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: وَلَہُ الۡجَوَارِ الۡمُنۡشَئٰتُ فِی الۡبَحۡرِ کَالۡاَعۡلَامِ ﴿ۚ۲۵﴾
verses.en: And His are the lofty ships reared aloft on the sea like mountains.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
All that is on it (earth) will pass away.

verses.ar: وَّیَبۡقٰی وَجۡہُ رَبِّکَ ذُو الۡجَلٰلِ وَالۡاِکۡرَامِ ﴿ۚ۲۸﴾
verses.en: And there will remain only the Person of thy Lord, Master of Glory and Honour.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: یَسۡـَٔلُہٗ مَنۡ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ ؕ کُلَّ یَوۡمٍ ہُوَ فِیۡ شَاۡنٍ ﴿ۚ۳۰﴾
verses.en: Of Him do beg all that are in the heavens and the earth. Every day He reveals Himself in a different state.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
[✲]Soon shall We attend to you, O ye two big groups!
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: یٰمَعۡشَرَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ اِنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تَنۡفُذُوۡا مِنۡ اَقۡطَارِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡفُذُوۡا ؕ لَا تَنۡفُذُوۡنَ اِلَّا بِسُلۡطٰنٍ ﴿ۚ۳۴﴾
verses.en: O company of Jinn and men! if you have power to go beyond the confines of the heavens and the earth, then do go. But you cannot go save with authority.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: یُرۡسَلُ عَلَیۡکُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّنۡ نَّارٍ ۬ۙ وَّنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنۡتَصِرٰنِ ﴿ۚ۳۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]There shall be sent against you a flame of fire, and smoke; and you shall not be able to help yourselves.
w: you shall be able to help yourselves

verses.en: Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: فَاِذَا انۡشَقَّتِ السَّمَآءُ فَکَانَتۡ وَرۡدَۃً کَالدِّہَانِ ﴿ۚ۳۸﴾
verses.en: And when the heaven is rent asunder, and becomes red like red hide —
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —

verses.ar: فَیَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّا یُسۡـَٔلُ عَنۡ ذَنۡۢبِہٖۤ اِنۡسٌ وَّلَا جَآنٌّ ﴿ۚ۴۰﴾
verses.en: On that day neither man nor Jinn will be asked about his sin.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: یُعۡرَفُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ بِسِیۡمٰہُمۡ فَیُؤۡخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِیۡ وَالۡاَقۡدَامِ ﴿ۚ۴۲﴾
verses.en: The guilty will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: ہٰذِہٖ جَہَنَّمُ الَّتِیۡ یُکَذِّبُ بِہَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ ﴿ۘ۴۴﴾
verses.en: This is the Hell which the guilty deny,
Between it and fierce boiling water will they go round.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
[✲]But for him who fears to stand before his Lord there are two Gardens —
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —
[✲]Having many varieties of trees.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
In both of them there are two fountains flowing free.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
Therein will be every kind of fruit in pairs.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: مُتَّکِـِٕیۡنَ عَلٰی فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُہَا مِنۡ اِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ ؕ وَجَنَا الۡجَنَّتَیۡنِ دَانٍ ﴿ۚ۵۵﴾
verses.en: They will recline on couches above carpets, the linings of which will be of thick brocade. And the ripe fruit of the two Gardens will be within easy reach.
w: the linings of which will be

verses.en: Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: فِیۡہِنَّ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرۡفِ ۙ لَمۡ یَطۡمِثۡہُنَّ اِنۡسٌ قَبۡلَہُمۡ وَلَا جَآنٌّ ﴿ۚ۵۷﴾
verses.en: Therein will also be chaste maidens of modest gaze, whom neither man nor Jinn will have touched before them —
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —
As if they were rubies and small pearls.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
The reward of goodness is nothing but goodness.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
And besides these two, there are two other Gardens —
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —
Dark green with foliage.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
Therein also will be two springs gushing forth with water.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
In both of them there will be all kinds of fruit, and dates and pomegranates.
w: there will be all kinds of fruit

verses.en: Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?
Therein will be maidens, good and beautiful —
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —
Fair maidens with lovely black eyes, well-guarded in pavilions —
w: fair maidens with lovely black eyes

verses.en: Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —

verses.ar: لَمۡ یَطۡمِثۡہُنَّ اِنۡسٌ قَبۡلَہُمۡ وَلَا جَآنٌّ ﴿ۚ۷۵﴾
verses.en: Whom neither man nor Jinn will have touched before them —
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny? —

verses.ar: مُتَّکِـِٕیۡنَ عَلٰی رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّعَبۡقَرِیٍّ حِسَانٍ ﴿ۚ۷۷﴾
verses.en: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful carpets.
Which, then, of the favours of your Lord will you twain deny?

verses.ar: تَبٰرَکَ اسۡمُ رَبِّکَ ذِی الۡجَلٰلِ وَالۡاِکۡرَامِ ﴿٪۷۹﴾
verses.en: Blessed is the name of thy Lord, Master of Glory and Honour.
